instruction: Switch the entire presentation's slide layout from landscape to portrait.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide orientation from landscape to portrait. The evaluator reads the PPTX file and checks if slide dimensions indicate portrait orientation (height > width). Custom getter extracts slide width and height using python-pptx library, metric verifies the orientation is portrait.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts presentation-level slide dimensions (width and height) using python-pptx library
Orientation determination logic is correct: portrait when height > width, landscape when width > height
Metric correctly compares result orientation with expected 'portrait' value
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing orientation to portrait for entire presentation, and evaluator checks presentation-level dimensions
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification to ensure changes are persisted
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts dimensions → determines orientation → metric validates against expected
Expected value 'portrait' is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Implementation is robust with proper error handling (empty file check, exception handling in getter)
No state timing issues: file-based verification after save is reliable
